name: Prayers of Sigmar
notes: Used by Warrior Priests. Prayers are not spells: protection against spells does not affect them. Cast as a Shoot/Spell action, 2d6 equal to or over the difficulty. Each caster starts with one spell rolled on a d12 and may learn more; a duplicate is re-rolled or its difficulty lowered by 1. Judgement call: text taken from the group's rules doc, already converted to d12.

spells.name: Hammer of Sigmar
spells.text: The Priest gains +2 S in melee and every wound he inflicts is doubled (2 wounds instead of 1). He must cast it again in each activation he wants to use it.

spells.name: Hearts of Steel
spells.text: Friendly models within 8" of the Priest are immune to Fear checks and to the Morale check for being charged alone in melee. The warband gets +1 Leadership on Rout checks. Lasts until the Priest is knocked down, stunned or out of action. Casting it again does not add more.

spells.name: Soulfire
spells.text: Every enemy model within 4" of the Priest suffers one S6 hit; Undead and Possessed suffer one S10 hit instead. No armour saves.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: The Priest is immune to all spells. In each Recovery phase roll a d12: on 1-4 the shield disappears.

spells.name: Healing Hand
spells.text: One model within 2" of the Priest (he may pick himself) is restored to full Wounds. Every friendly model within 2" that is stunned or knocked down stands up and fights normally.

spells.name: Armour of Righteousness
spells.text: The Priest's Armour Value becomes 10 (replacing his normal armour). He causes fear and is immune to fear. Lasts until his next Shoot/Spell action.
